authority: Structured numerical authority for ordinary carried-mass burden.
principle: Only equipment, supplies, cargo, prisoners, captured items, and other external mass actually carried in the scene contribute to burden.
total_external_load_kg: sum of worn armor, weapons, ammunition, tools, consumables, supplies, cargo, carried people, and captured equipment
rules: No body mass or height enters the formula.
A carried prisoner or cargo changes burden immediately.
Dropped, transferred, consumed, destroyed, or stored items stop contributing when custody changes.
Training implements used only inside a narrated drill are activity context, not persistent character equipment unless they become narratively consequential objects.
There is no dedicated weight-release combat action.
